value: Re-read today: page last updated 02 Sep 2026. Recreational: register with GCAA, 5 kg or less, daytime, VLOS, no more than 400 feet AGL, green zone only, 5 km from airports. Operators: UOA fee AED 1,200 with security clearance, operator registration letter and E-Publications subscription proof, flight permission per red zone flight, security clearance approval for cameras. Accident and loss of control reported immediately; no hour deadline stated. GCAA's own UAS registration page adds UOA processing time of 3 weeks and operational permission 14 working days. These recreational limits are not CAR-UAC commercial limits.
conflicts: The 3 h reporting deadline claimed elsewhere is not on either page
